message: マスクメロン入手法

name: Nanaka
message: 「Welcome!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What? Are you saying I shouldn't be here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure you're okay to be up?」
Nanaka seemed completely back to normal as she helped out at Yuugiri-an.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course I am.」

name: Synn
message: 「You looked really unwell yesterday, so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That was just a fluke. Even I'm a delicate maiden, so I have days like that too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if you say so.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey. Isn't that the part where you're supposed to retort, 'Who's a delicate maiden?!'」

name: Synn
message: 「...As long as you're okay, that's all that matters.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「E-eh, ah, r-right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Just to be safe, don't you think you should take today off?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, well, I'm totally fine, so...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, it's Synn-kun~ Sneaking into her bed?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-what are you suddenly talking about?!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Oh, finally?! You've finally gone that far?! You're quite the sly dog, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's the middle of the day right now.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「How bold, doing it in broad daylight~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's how you're gonna play it...」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「What?! Did you sleep with her?!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Judging by how slender he is, there's a good chance Synn was the one who got taken to bed.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「There's no time to waste! As an apostle of truth, I have to spread this scoop right away!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not the truth to begin with.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I neither got held nor did any holding!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah! Even Bubuzuke is here!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I heard that you collapsed yesterday, you see.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ria-senpai sure runs her mouth...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As a get-well gift, I went and bought some buns--some pussy-buns, that is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't say such obscene things in broad daylight!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I only said I bought some sweet buns, how mean of you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop spamming it when you know full well how it sounds!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, feeling under the weather every now and then isn't so bad, is it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Someone special might worry about you. And you get canned peaches or muskmelons out of it, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see! Though even without getting sick, at your place, Misasagi-senpai, you could have as much as you want.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The harsh reality of a stratified society.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Could it be that you would have preferred a muskmelon instead?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. A muskmelon is out of my league, though if a soccer ball I picked up will do.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I never said anything like that! Jeez, what do you take me for!」
Yeah. That's the usual Nanaka. She looks fine.

name: Misasagi
message: 「If it's something the President gives you, wouldn't you be happy no matter what it is?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I-I-It's not like that at all!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now, don't get so worked up. So, why were you feeling unwell?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Did you cook some celebratory red bean rice?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ages ago!」

name: Synn
message: 「Red bean rice, huh... I've even forgotten what it tastes like...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Come to think of it, there was a food like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, how pitiful.」
